newsitem.title: UK: Policy set for stable, competitive pound -Beckett.
newsitem.headline: Policy set for stable, competitive pound -Beckett.

text.p: This month's UK budget has put the policies in place needed to produce the "stable and competive" exchange rate that the government desires, Trade and Industry Secretary Margaret Beckett said on Wednesday.
"We believe that the actions that the chancellor has taken will create those circumstances in the longer term," Beckett told a news conference devoted to competitiveness.
The rise in sterling to the highest level against the mark since September 1989 had "taken most people slightly by surprise", Beckett added.
